title.zh: v2.0.37 钢琴卷帘经典和弦走向大师套件、力度泳道动态工具栏与手册直达联动
title.en: v2.0.37 Piano Roll Diatonic Chord Progression Suite, Velocity Lane Dynamics Toolbar & Manual Deep-Linking

highlights.zh: **经典和弦走向套件（Diatonic Chord Progression Suite）**：在钢琴卷帘 Deck 2 新增和弦走向编配套件。内置 Pop 4-Chords (I-V-vi-IV)、Emotional Lift (vi-IV-I-V)、Jazz 2-5-1 (ii-V-I-vi)、王道进行 J-Pop (IV-V-iii-vi)、Epic Minor (i-VI-III-VII)、Blues & Rock (I-IV-I-V)、Dorian Funk (i-IV) 及卡农走向 (Canon in D) 等 8 大经典和弦走向；结合当前选定调式音阶实时推导自然音阶级数和弦，支持一键实时多音试听与一键盖印平铺至全小节，创作和声骨架如虎添翼。
highlights.en: **Diatonic Chord Progression Suite**: Introduced a comprehensive progression authoring engine in Deck 2. Features 8 classic chord progressions (Pop 4-Chords, Emotional Lift, Jazz 2-5-1, Royal Road/J-Pop, Epic Minor, Blues & Rock, Dorian Funk, Canon in D) derived dynamically from the active scale and root key. Includes instant polyphonic chord auditioning and 1-click timeline stamping across bars with animated HUD confirmation.

highlights.zh: **力度泳道独立工具栏与声学动态塑形（Velocity Lane Dynamics Toolbar）**：在力度泳道表头增设专属磨砂玻璃硬件工具栏，提供人性化微动态（Humanize ±10 模拟真实演奏手感）、动态压缩（Compress 0.5 压缩比收拢极端力度）、线性渐强渐弱（Ramp ↗ / Ramp ↘）及基准力度（Level 100）等 5 大批处理工具；未选中音符时智能作用于全轨音符，大幅提升音符动态塑形效率。
highlights.en: **Velocity Lane Dynamics Toolbar**: Integrated a dedicated frosted hardware toolbar directly atop the velocity lane. Equips 5 dynamic shaping tools: Humanize (deterministic ±10 micro-dynamics jitter), Compress (0.5 ratio dynamic leveling toward 85 velocity), Ramp Up/Down (linear chronological crescendos and decrescendos), and Level 100. Gracefully applies to note selections or the entire track.

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘直达用户手册深层联动（Contextual Help Deep-Link）**：在 Deck 1 控制台右侧新增专属「卷帘手册 (Guide)」帮助按钮，轻点即可直达全功能用户手册的「编曲与钢琴卷帘 (Sequencer & Piano Roll)」专属章节，随时查阅音阶折叠、和弦印章、快捷键与高级编辑技巧，彻底打通工具操作与教学指导。
highlights.en: **Contextual Help Deep-Linking**: Added a dedicated "Guide" button to the right of Deck 1 that deep-links directly into the User Manual"s "Sequencer & Piano Roll" chapter, providing instant access to scale theory, chord stamping workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and power-user tips without losing editing context.
